anne-docs: Opened a docs PR with guidance on audit-log sampling, retention windows, and short SDK/curl snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5999

mike-security: Quick asks: don't use 'we may keep' or 'indefinitely' in SOC2-facing text; call out legal-hold contact and access controls on exports.

anne-docs: Current line: 'Logs are kept 90 days by default; exports for compliance may be kept longer.' Thoughts?

mike-security: Prefer: 'Customer audit logs are retained for 90 days by default. Legal holds or regulatory obligations can extend retention; exported data is subject to access controls.'

pratyusha-eng: Pushed three snippets for the PR: python, TS, curl. Python sampling example: ```python
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.query_events(sample=0.01, start='2025-02-01', end='2025-03-03')
print(resp['total'])
```

anne-docs: Add a one-line pseudonymization example and a legal-hold contact. Jordan?

jordan-legal: Use phrase 'as required by law or contractual obligations' and add legal@redwood.com for holds. Also mention example IDs are pseudonymized.

anne-docs: Added pseudonymized JSON snippet: { "user_id": "sha256:3f2a9b...", "event": "model.generate", "ts": "2025-03-01T12:00:00Z" }

mike-security: Also add a short callout about sampling bias: samples can miss rare anomalies; recommend full export for formal investigations.

anne-docs: Done. Plan to merge after security + legal ACK. @doc-bot please add 'security-reviewed' label on merge.
